ground_clearance_standard_pasm_max_din.source: porsche_usa_specs (4.9 in = 124.5 mm / 125 mm DIN standard PASM; PASM Sport -10 mm = 115 mm / 4.5 in)

brakes_pccb.system: Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB), internally vented and cross-drilled carbon-ceramic discs, Yellow calipers

front.caliper: 10-piston aluminum monobloc fixed caliper, Yellow with black PORSCHE script (mounted trailing / rear of axle)

rear.caliper: 4-piston aluminum monobloc fixed caliper, Yellow with black PORSCHE script (mounted leading / front of axle)

combustion_engine.configuration: 6-cylinder boxer (horizontally opposed), rear-mounted, water-cooled, beltless front accessory drive

turbochargers.type: Electric exhaust gas turbochargers (eTurbo) with integrated electric motor on shaft between turbine and compressor

combustion_engine.exhaust: Standard titanium sports exhaust system (rear silencer + twin double-barrel titanium/Turbonite tips, -6.8 kg vs predecessor; GPF fitted)

electric_motor_pdk.type: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with internal rotor, integrated in PDK bellhousing

hv_battery.type: Liquid-cooled lithium-ion battery (216 round cells), front luggage compartment

lv_starter_battery.type: Compact LiFePO4 12V starter battery behind rear seats

transmission.code: CDU.50 (2026 992T2 Porsche PET plate 302-000; 8-speed hybrid PDK)
transmission.type: 8-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) dual-clutch transaxle reinforced for T-Hybrid
transmission.drive_layout: PTM all-wheel drive with map-controlled water-cooled front axle differential (up to 500 Nm to front axle) + PTV Plus electronically controlled rear diff lock

chassis_weights_and_aero.front_suspension: MacPherson strut with wishbones, trailing arms, spring struts, anti-roll bar, standard 400V ehPDCC
chassis_weights_and_aero.rear_suspension: Lightweight 5-link multi-link axle, anti-roll bar, standard rear-axle steering, standard 400V ehPDCC
chassis_weights_and_aero.damping: PASM electronically controlled damping (NORMAL / SPORT); optional PASM Sport -10 mm
